visualCharacteristics: Listing view: section heading, view title and one unit per item, with an exposed filter form and pager. Default: text slabs with numbered pager (news). Grid: a feature card and service link cards with load-more (services). Media: image slabs with load-more, no heading or form (events).
contentPattern: Rows: section heading, view title, then one row per listing item (title link, date, type, text, image as available).
usage: News, services and events listing pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any filterable listing of news, services or events; pick grid for service cards and media for image-led event listings.
